rationale: The core statistical choice is exactly right for this design: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with time explicitly kept as a 4-level factor and the interaction coefficients retained so per-time-point direction is recoverable, plus an explicit warning not to conflate the interaction with main effects. QC precedes modeling (PCA, sample-correlation, sample-name reconciliation, VST) though library sizes and an explicit action policy for a flagged outlier are not stated, and the low-count filter is described only as "near-zero across all samples" without a concrete rule, albeit correctly minimal and applied before dispersion estimation. Normalization is handled correctly inside the model from raw integer counts with VST reserved for visualization. FDR is BH at padj < 0.05 with independent filtering, but no lfcShrink is specified for the reported per-time-point effects; the design formula lacks explicit reference-level statements (t0, untreated). Enrichment names two collections with the tested-gene universe as background and BH adjustment, but omits collection versions, a gene-set size window, and the GSEA ranking metric; the report plan covers design, thresholds and significant-gene counts but not software versions.
